title: Extend source_id conformance evidence for ordinary-root edge states and read isolation
outcome: The source_id conformance map explicitly covers ordinary-root admission edge cases and capture read isolation with deterministic public-boundary tests, while preserving the current no-gitlink compatibility contract.
acceptance: Runtime pre-change/new capture comparisons cover actual sparse and conflicted ordinary roots plus controlled read races, recording identical success/value or identical existing refusal rather than adding new admission rules.

Direct source-capture fixtures cover raw path/Unicode ordering, unsafe encoding and case/alias behavior on the platforms where each is observable; unsupported platform cases are reported rather than silently treated as passed.
Controlled capture fixtures establish source, index, object and configuration preservation and denial of hook/filter/network execution; each mapped case cites its own exact-input validation.
